title: Walk to Broadway / 1 BR/Balcony | Free Parking
description:
Stay in the heart of downtown Nashville! Stylish 1BR with brand-new Roku Smart TVs, private balcony, full kitchen, queen sleeper sofa, and free parking. Walk to Broadway, City Winery, Music City Center, Bridgestone Arena, restaurants, nightlife, plus enjoy the pool and fitness center.

STR Permit # T2022050264

The space
This modern 1-bedroom apartment features a private balcony, full kitchen, and comfortable living space with a sleeper sofa. Perfect for couples, friends, or business travelers. Located minutes from downtown Nashville, restaurants, and nightlife. Guests also have access to building amenities including a pool, fitness center, and lounge areas. Free parking included. Permit/Registration #: T2022050264

Guest access
Guests have full access to the entire apartment, including the private bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, and living area. Guests can also enjoy the private balcony. In addition, guests have access to shared building amenities including the pool, fitness center, and lounge areas. One free parking space is included.

Other things to note
Please note this is a residential building, so guests are expected to be respectful of neighbors and follow building rules. No parties or events allowed. Quiet hours may apply. Parking is limited to the assigned space only. Building amenities (pool, fitness center, lounge) are shared and subject to availability and building guidelines.
